Chronicle needs [Git](https://git-scm.com/downloads) 2.45 or newer. Builds are not signed yet, so the system warns on first launch: see [First launch](https://github.com/betrayalove/git-gui#first-launch). `SHA256SUMS.txt` lists the checksums of all files.
